installation.reason: Migrated calibration (DCC) binding for the calibration-direct-accreditation, calibration-capability, nmi-legal-mandate and test-report-supported-dcc use cases. The gate 0-6 evaluators for direct accreditation, bounded operational scopes, statutory mandates, measurement-group coverage, CMC floors and instrument-calibration support of test reports are implemented; conformity rules and native DCC XML are not.

carrierAndSchema.statusListCarrier: BitstringStatusListCredential with the VCDM 2.0 context only; this binding's issuers declare its status-list schema, the shared roots' issuers (the state, Global ACI) the RM v1 status-list schema
carrierAndSchema.sharedRootCarriers: The accreditation body is the RM binding's NAB, with the same two roots, signed once in the RM v1 fixtures and read here with the RM v1 carriers: the state's appointment APP-NAB (VerifiableAuthorisationForTrustChain, VCDM 2.0 and RM v1 contexts, schema rm/1/appointment.json) and Global ACI's recognition REC-NAB (RecognizedEntityCredential, VCDM 2.0 and the Recognized Entities stand-in context, schema rm/1/recognized-entity.json). A CalAccreditation names both in its termsOfUse (IssuedUnderPolicy, RecognitionPolicy) and may mirror the recognition as issuer.recognizedIn
carrierAndSchema.decimalEncoding: JSON strings typed xsd:decimal for every value, bound, uncertainty and CMC floor
carrierAndSchema.nativeRepresentation: A JSON-LD simplification of a DCC's measurement results; native DCC XML is not carried in this experimental binding

cardinality.authorizingReferenceSelection: by-the-type-each-named-credential-resolves-to, per route; a named credential that cannot be read leaves it not_established; several of one type not_established
cardinality.selectedGroups: every selected measurement group is a separate required claim; the request is a conjunction over them

discoveryAndIntegrity.digestCarrier: digestSRI on the termsOfUse or evidence entry that names the credential (VCDM 2.0 section 5.3)
discoveryAndIntegrity.independentGrantBinding: unsupported: authority is recognized only through termsOfUse IssuedUnderPolicy entries on the credential chain (the entry's id is the grant)

rules: The grant's grantee (accreditation, operational scope or mandate) equals the actor issuing the calibration certificate.
The grant permits issuing calibration certificates, or, for a test report under direct accreditation, issuing test reports (anchor purpose accredit-testing-laboratories).
An operational scope is issued by its own grantee, and the accreditation it cites names that grantee and permits maintaining a calibration scope.
Every grant on the route was in force at the certificate's activity time.

quantityValues.mapping: each value is one si:real; every JSON-LD term named after a D-SI element (real, label, quantityTypeQUDT, value, unit, measurementUncertaintyUnivariate, expandedMU, valueExpandedMU, coverageFactor, coverageProbability, distribution) expands in this binding's vc4qi.example namespace and carries that element's meaning; numbers are xsd:decimal strings, the subset of si:decimalType without sign, exponent or NaN

quantityKinds.reference: QUDT quantity kinds by local name, as D-SI's quantityTypeQUDT carries them

scopeAndMapping.methodRule: every method a group names must be allowed by the same record; a record restricting methods against a group naming none is not_established (no empty-array bypass)
scopeAndMapping.groupRule: every result of a group names the same quantity kind (quantityTypeQUDT), which is the group's; one complete record must cover the group's quantity kind, methods and every result; groups never combine and a later group cannot erase an earlier failure
scopeAndMapping.cmcFloor: when the verifier profile applies it, an expanded uncertainty below the record's admitted CMC contradicts scope; independent of conformity
scopeAndMapping.boundedProjection: every operational-scope record lies within one accreditation record: same quantity kind, a subset of its methods, a range inside its range and, when the profile applies the CMC floor, a stated floor not below the accreditation's; claims are covered by the operational scope only

routesAndRestrictions.issuerStanding: CA's issuer stands behind CA when it is a configured anchor for the route's purpose (accredit-calibration-laboratories, or accredit-testing-laboratories for a test report); else, when the profile accepts appointments, through the usable, unsuspended appointment CA names in an IssuedUnderPolicy, issued by an anchor for the appointer purpose, about CA's issuer, permitting CalAccreditation under its schema in the required jurisdiction and in force at the activity time; else, when the profile accepts recognitions, through the usable, unsuspended recognition CA names in a RecognitionPolicy, issued by an anchor for the recognizer purpose, recognizing CA's issuer to accredit with the purpose's main scope (Calibration or Testing under ISO/IEC 17025:2017) in force at the activity time. The same check as the RM binding (grantIssuerStanding); recognition never establishes authority or QI scope

protectionTimeAndResolution.statusMechanism: W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0: multibase base64url GZIP encodedList, bounded decompression

supportAndDisclosure.requiredSupport: a CalTestReport requires one cited CalCertificate (evidence CalCalibrationReference) for the same instrument and quantity kinds, calibrated before the test and valid at it, whose own authority holds with every measurement group covered; certificates have no support obligation
